### COMPETITOR RANKING TABLE

*Ranked by Like Engagement Rate (Avg Likes / Followers):*

| Handle | Followers | Avg Likes | Eng Rate | Top Content Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **@dhavalkataria_** | 50,768 | 9,256.3 | **18.23%** | DM automation lead-magnets (e.g., "Comment CFO / PROOF") |
| **@favourite.engineer** | 157,545 | 9,202.2 | **5.84%** | Direct monetization hooks & AI workflows (e.g., "Pay your rent with Claude") |
| **@aryamanupmanyu** | 74,584 | 2,008.5 | **2.69%** | AI Agent builds & automated comment CTA workflows |
| **@thevarunmayya** | 1,274,928 | 14,306.2 | **1.12%** | High-authority interviews (Nadella, Pichai) & macro AI trends |
| **@nick_saraev** | 665,471 | 3,716.7 | **0.56%** | Curated resource packs & prompt libraries with keyword triggers |
| **@arshman** | 375,237 | 2,012.8 | **0.54%** | Deep-dive troubleshooting for Claude & LLM power features |
| **@vaibhavsisinty** | 2,128,381 | 9,662.3 | **0.45%** | Tech news curation & emerging hardware/AGI updates |
| **@ishansharma7390** | 1,271,654 | 4,064.4 | **0.32%** | Career roadmaps, fear-of-replacement hooks, lifestyle relatability |
| **@nivedan.ai** | 525,277 | 506.1 | **0.10%** | Milestone announcements & personal credential flexes |

*(Reference for **@garvit.irl**: 6,095 followers | 290.1 avg likes | 1,655.4 median comments | **31.92%** overall ER).*

---

### GROWTH GAPS

1. **Lack of Inbound DM Automation ("Keyword-Triggered CTAs"):**
   Top performers in the high-engagement tier (**@dhavalkataria_** at 18.23% and **@aryamanupmanyu** at 2.69%) generate tens of thousands of likes and comments using direct ManyChat triggers ("Comment 'CFO'", "Comment 'AI'"). Garvit’s transcript on the free open-source GitHub tool explains the tool verbally but drops the conversion loop at the end, failing to capture distribution through automated keyword comments.

2. **Unfocused Content Mix (Philosophical/Vlog vs. Tangible Utility):**
   Garvit spends screen time on early-creator self-reflection (*"Tumhe pata hai I have always wanted to be a content creator..."*) and generic motivational platitudes (*"Cristiano Ronaldo... King Kohli... I am the best"*). In contrast, accounts scaling rapidly (**@favourite.engineer**) focus entirely on high-stakes, outcome-oriented hooks (*"Claude can literally pay your rent"*, *"NotebookLM + YouTube = 🤑"*).

3. **Missing Workflow Proof & Step-by-Step Problem Solving:**
   Creators like **@arshman** and **@favourite.engineer** hit breakout views by addressing hyper-specific technical pain points (e.g., hitting Claude usage limits or building a no-code agency). Garvit surfaces useful finds (like the Speed AI free open-source alternative), but lacks the over-the-shoulder visual demonstration of how to deploy and run it with API keys.

---

### RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (Next 7 Days)

1. **Deploy a "Comment to Receive" Inbound Funnel on Free Tools:**
   Take the GitHub open-source alternative discussed in the transcript and re-record it with an explicit hook: *"Stop paying ₹5,000/month for AI subscriptions."* End with: *"Comment 'SPEED' and I’ll DM you the exact GitHub repository link and setup guide."* Connect this to ManyChat to turn viewers into active commenters.

2. **Shift Hooks from Identity/Motivation to Direct Financial/Time ROI:**
   Retire the generic athlete/mindset scripts for the next 7 days. Model **@favourite.engineer**’s framing: Hook viewers with tangible leverage in the first 3 seconds (e.g., *"How this open-source tool replaces 3 paid developer tools"* rather than *"I always wanted to be a creator"*).

3. **Publish a Step-by-Step Screen Recording Tutorial Reel:**
   Deliver on the technical promise of the third transcript: Show a split-screen or direct screencast showing where to paste the API key and how the local UI looks running in real time. Demonstrating proof of execution will convert high comment rates into saves, shares, and follower conversions.
